name: claude-mods
description: A small app store of Claude Code mods. Browse, pick what you like, install it with one line.

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Say "install mods a, b" in any session: Claude installs, updates or removes mods from this store the way each mod's README describes.

plugins.name: limit-meter
plugins.description: Shows your 5-hour and weekly usage limits and the context fill under the prompt, with colored bars and the time until each limit resets.

plugins.name: voice-bar
plugins.description: Speak and send buttons above the prompt: dictate with Handy (offline speech-to-text), see at a glance whether it is listening, and send with one click.
